A business owner's confidence jumped from a five to a nine. Here is how.

Kevin Trudeau tells of a one-on-one call with a man whose business was already doing well. Asked how confident he was of reaching his target, he said maybe a five out of ten.

They did the dream expansion process first. When Kevin asked again, the target was bigger and the confidence had jumped to a nine. Kevin calls it magic.

What would change if you dreamed bigger before setting a target?

#ad #confidence #success #kevintrudeau

Today's gurus keep selling something new. The old formula was simple.

Kevin Trudeau says the old success books told you to write down what you want. He says almost no new success teacher says it today, and that they keep inventing something new to sell a new seminar.

He points back to Napoleon Hill's Think and Grow Rich: define your dream, and write it down. A dream that stays in your head is not yet in the physical world.

Have you ever written your goal on paper?

#ad #success #goals #kevintrudeau

Why do things arrive just when you stop chasing them?

Kevin Trudeau describes trying and trying, hitting obstacle after obstacle, and finally giving up. Then, sometime later, the thing arrives, and people say it happened when they least expected it.

He says that is because you released attachment to the outcome. You stopped needing it and stopped thinking you would only feel good once you had it. You settled into feeling okay now.

When did something finally come once you stopped forcing it?
